patches.value: IREI MVP Build Template — Business Rules

This sheet preserves the NGO B v12 workbook logic and states how it is simplified for the one-time MVP v1 build. Colour coding follows v12: blue=input, black=formula, purple=generated, orange=review, grey=legacy/reference, green=output.
NGO B v12 is the business-logic prototype. Tapestry / ENF July 7 is the latest demo source of truth where it supersedes generic NGO B assumptions.
This workbook combines Build 1 template structure and Build 2 NGO B / ENF demo rows. The 17 populated rows are examples, not the fixed future platform shape.
Digital build must support additional organizations and properties using the same DATA_* structure.
